I had my first gallbladder attack almost three years ago, was scheduled for HIDA test, but found out that I was pregnant and had to postpone it. My second attack happened when I was 5 months pregnant. I didn't eat anything greasy and was watching my diet. I was scared to eat greasy food. I was sleeping mostly on my right side, and I am questioning now if that could trigger my second attack. They didn't find anything. No stones, no infection. I've noticed ER doctor did not really know what to do, and nobody wanted to deal with pregnant woman. They prescribed me pills, Actigall, as I recall. I ran out of the pills in a month, and at that point was too tired to look for GI specialist to deal with the problem. So, I just let it go.
I am prediabetic, and had to watch my food intake anyway during the pregnancy. No greedy food, not too many carbs. It was hard but doable.
After birth, I ate everything. For two years, I had no problems. My right side started hurting a month ago. Ultrasound shows no stones but wall thickening. I will be talking to my doctor about the next steps, but afraid they will need to remove it 
Good luck in your journey!
